entry.summary:
People have been trapped in cars and homes, CBDs have flooded and towns around the region have seen roads closed as weather warnings are in place across the South Island | Subscribe: https://www.youtube.com/RNZVideo?sub_confirmation=1

⚠️ RNZ is New Zealand's statutory civil defence lifeline radio broadcaster, providing vital information and updates as they come to hand. All frequencies can be found at rnz.co.nz/listen
